newsitem.title: UK: NWE NAPHTHA $1 LOWER AS FUTURES DICTATE MOVEMENTS.
newsitem.headline: NWE NAPHTHA $1 LOWER AS FUTURES DICTATE MOVEMENTS.

text.p: Naphtha swaps fell back by around $1 on Thursday on a quiet day that failed to see any noticeable resumption of physical bidding at the highs of $196-$197 that had been seen Wednesday.

Swap movements were seen being largely dictated by fluctuations on futures, leaving August $.50-$0.75 lower on the day at $193.75-$195 and September losing $1.00-$1.50 to hit the $190-$190.50 bid-offer range.
Early rumoured swap trades at $10.75 and $189.50 were not followed by any publicly declared deals as the physical market remained viewed buoyant despite a closed Med arb to Asia.
